title: ledger-db deadlocks during month-end invoicing run
text: Month-end invoicing blocked ~6h by MySQL row-lock deadlocks on ledger_entries in ledger-db. Mitigated by batching. Root cause: MySQL isolation semantics for concurrent ledger writes. Follow-up: RFC-007.

title: Friday deploy broke Stripe webhook signature checks
text: A Friday afternoon deploy of payments-gateway broke webhook signature verification for ~3h. Manual rollback. Contributing factor: low staffing on Friday evening, no fast rollback in deploy-pipeline.

title: Refund abuse spike from trial-to-paid accounts
text: 41 accounts in July converted from trial, paid for a monthly plan, then requested a full refund at day 25-29 under the 30-day refund policy. Approx $18k lost. Suggest shortening the refund window.

title: Enforce 14-day refund window for monthly plans in refund-engine
text: Per the Aug 12 decision in #billing: monthly plans refundable within 14 days, effective Sept 1. Annual plans keep prorated refunds.

title: Exclude invoices and ledger records from 90-day deletion job
text: Auditor requirement: retain invoices and ledger records for 7 years. Update the deletion job in analytics-warehouse to skip them.

title: Enterprise SSO: Okta SAML support + per-workspace enforcement
text: Support Okta via SAML in auth-service, plus enforcement of SSO per workspace. Blocking Globex, Initech, Umbrella deals.

title: Atlas: dual-write ledger entries to Postgres
text: Write every ledger entry to both MySQL and Postgres ledger-db during Project Atlas so cutover can be verified.

title: Atlas: cutover runbook and checksum verification
text: Write the cutover runbook for Oct 28 and verify ledger checksums between MySQL and Postgres.

title: Usage meter consumer from kafka-events
text: Consume usage events from kafka-events and aggregate them into billable meters in billing-service for Usage-Based Pricing.

title: Usage dashboard dbt models
text: dbt models in analytics-warehouse for the customer-facing usage dashboard (Usage-Based Pricing).

title: Churn score v2 with support ticket features
text: Add support ticket volume and refund requests as features to churn-model. Alerts go to Customer Success (Jordan's team).
